ev.q: Of the six diagnoses tracked in 2014, cardiovascular disease (44%) was the most common diagnosis among adult day services center participants
Percentage of Adult Day Services Center Participants
cardiovascular disease (44%) was the most common diagnosis among adult day services center participants
Source: National Study of Long-Term Care Providers, 2014

methods_quotes.q: The denominator used to calculate these percentages is 282,200
Because diagnoses are not mutually exclusive, percentages add up to more than 100 percent.
